messages.subject: Timing of the output
parts:
Hi,
  I developed some shiny pages where data processing is a bit heavy and takes some time.Is there a way to inform the user that things are going on and the process is not stuck? I can redirect all my processing outpout to a renderPrint, but of course it gets updated together with all the other widgets, at the end of the processing.The only real time information the user has is in the background R console, but it is not as immediate as if it were on the page itself...

Thanks for your help, Attilio
